spans.text: Ah, I never thought I'd come back here again. Sure brings back memories.
The only things here are a beat-up old base and a bunch of broken-down cannons. What's there to be nostalgic about?
Well, this used to be my place, after all.
The area wasn't this run-down the last time we came on a mission, was it?
I suppose I should be glad to see a former enemy in this sorry state, but somehow I'm having mixed feelings.
I mean, even the walls are in ruins. It all looks pretty desolate.
Hey, don't look at me like that!
This was all thanks to Griffin!
Just waxing sentimental.
To think that Sangvis Ferri, who used to be a thorn in our side, was reduced to nothing just like that...
I guess change is the only constant in this world, as they say.
How do you feel about seeing your former territory in this state?
Eh, I'm not that bothered, honestly...
I left shortly after I was stationed here.
Also, managing all those units was super tiring, I definitely didn't miss that part.
RO! Look! I picked up something neat!
...Stop adding to the number of Dinergates in the base! Put that back!
Speaking of which, I've been leading the way for you this whole time.
So would you mind placing just a teensy bit of trust in me?
You could start by loosening the rope around my neck, how about that?
Hahahahahaha!
No!
SOP-II bares her claws. She seems to prefer them as weapons over her gun.
I might trust you more if you were just a head.
If you're planning to run away while our guard is lowered, I'd advise you to give up on that plan.
R-Relax, I mean, look at the state of this place, there's no way I'd want to flee back to Sangvis Ferri now.
We're almost there, SOP-II. We'll be splitting up soon.
Huh? Already?
The main control room is on the other side.
You and Architect should go take a walk around the place while I hack the Sangvis systems.
While this isn't our main task, it could get Gager's attention.
Are you sure that's alright?
Pretty sure of yourself, aren't you?
That lady knight of mine isn't exactly a slouch in combat, you know?
You hardly have to worry about us.
Since you seem so convinced that we're no match for her, why don't you strap a bomb to yourself and blow yourself up when Gager gets close?
Urgh... That's just despicable...
Then dispense with the nonsense. Right now, we are not enemies with S.F.
If you could be more than just bait, then maybe Gager could come back with us in one piece.
So you want me to talk her into surrendering...?
She'd probably kill me on the spot if I said that.
Either Gager kills you or we do, take your pick.
Time's running short, I'll be heading to the main control room.
Be careful, RO...
Do you want to bring Banana with you?
Absolutely not.
So, RO635 said she's off to the main control room...
But isn't S.F. pretty much dissolved at this point? What info could there be that's worth knowing?
That's none of your business.
So cold—
You're really suspicious, you know?
Am I?
I've behaved myself so far, how could I be suspicious?
The more nonchalant you act, the more suspicious it looks to me.
We're using you as bait to catch a friend of yours.
Do you really not care about that?
If I were in your position, I'd never sell out my teammates!
Aw, do you really think I have the IQ points needed to think about these rock-and-a-hard-place problems?
What kind of answer are you expecting from me, anyway?
If I said yes, wouldn't that make me out to be a cold-hearted bitch? You can't trust people like that at all.
And if I said no, that means I still feel for S.F., right? Sure, it proves that I'm not entirely heartless, but then you'd have an excuse to scrap me on the spot.
So I'd be screwed either way, don't you think?
Hmm... Okay, that sort of makes sense.
So in conclusion, we can't go wrong with scrapping you!
You just want to scrap me, don't you?!
Remember, we need to finish the Commander's mission! The mission is very important, right?
Let's stop wasting time on this subject!
For some reason, it feels particularly insulting to hear this from a Sangvis...
Even if S.F. is done for, it doesn't mean you can be THAT relaxed.
You've seen it, haven't you? This place still looks like a base, but it's essentially an empty shell now.
Whoever did this was thorough... Even the security cameras I installed are gone.
Something must have happened here.
We should be the first to investigate this place.
Who could have done this?
Do I have to spell it out for you? Only my lady knight would do something as tiring and thankless as this.
Gager?! So she IS here!
If RO runs into her, I wonder if she'll be okay...
Don't worry. With her neural upgrade, Miss RO isn't a pushover either.
Besides...
Architect pauses. Then she flashes a grin at SOP-II.
She's going to come for me first~
The two of you must've been real close.
Since you get along so well, why are you still lazing around in Griffin?
Aw, change is the only constant, after all.
—Shhh.
Something's trying to surround us...
Huh... I thought they'd become a scattered mob after losing their commander.
They're pretty united, aren't they?
At last the truth is revealed!
So it WAS you, wasn't it?
I can scrap you now, right? Can I?
Heyheyhey! Don't get excited just because you got surrounded! I told you, it wasn't me!
If you don't believe me, why don't you throw me into their ranks!
They'll finish me off without hesitation!
Whum—
An ear-piercing screech of feedback blasts through the PA system as the two of them argue.
—Attention.
That's Gager's voice.
Oho, she hasn't changed a bit.
Listen up, Griffin Dolls.
You have stepped into my trap.
Release Architect immediately.
Otherwise... All the surrounding cannon emplacements have been aimed at this place.
You have five minutes to decide. Once time is up, I will blast this place until not even your stains remain.
And what if I don't hand her over?
Then I will open fire anyway.
Hey... Are you serious?
If you do that, I'll be blown to bits as well, won't I?
At last, she took the bait! Gager can't be far!
Still, I didn't expect her to be able to control the Jupiter Cannons I left behind.
The mortars around the base are all top-of-the-line! I built them personally to protect myself!
We're doomed!
What's so scary about that?
All we need to do is take out those cannons, right?
We've wrecked so many of those we lost count.
Urgh... Would you mind not denying the value of my existence so casually...
But before that, we need to eliminate all the Sangvis forces trying to surround us!
You get out there too!
Ehh... Can't I have a tea break on the sidelines or something?
If you want to rest, I can give you a dirt nap right now.
Gee... I'm going... I'm going, okay?!
(Pants)
I...I wonder if I've been locked up for too long...
I feel really out of shape...
Useless! These enemies aren't even worth toying with!
Oh come on, I wasn't expressly designed for combat, you know!
Still, at least we made it out of there... Wait a minute, five minutes has come and gone, right?
She said all the cannons were sighted on our position, but there was no boom in the end.
Where the hell has she run off to? I thought she'd be barking at us over the intercom by now.
But in the end, we didn't hear a peep out of her. Did we scare her away?
I doubt it...
BOOM!
A massive explosion erupts from the other side of the base.
What the hell, that shot was totally off! Looks like she didn't absorb any of the control techniques I taught her.
Hold on, isn't that the direction of the control room where RO has gone?
Huh? So she wasn't aiming at us?
Of course not, you dumbass!
Hurry up and move, we need to find RO right away!
